diagnostic_evidence.quote: are independent random matrices whose entries are mean zero, unit variance,  subgaussian random variables, with subgaussian norm  bounded by $K \geq 1$.
where $\{\V{\omega}_j\}_{j=1}^d$ are independent, and have independent entries with zero mean and unit variance
by~\cite[Lemma 3.4.2]{vershynin2018high}, $\V{\omega}_j\t\V{y}$ is subgaussian with norm  $\|\V{\omega}_j\t\V{y}\|_{\Psi_2}\le C_S K \|\V{y}\|_2$

issues.failure_explanation: Definition def:subgauss only requires the factor matrices to be mutually independent with mean-zero, unit-variance, subgaussian entries; independence of entries within each factor is never assumed. The proof of lem:added-1 nevertheless uses 'the independence of the entries' (needed for the zero-mean product and for the covariance to be diagonal), and lem:kronrank1 invokes [Vershynin, Lemma 3.4.2], which requires independent coordinates. Under the stated hypotheses the lemma is false: if all entries of one factor equal a single standard Gaussian (mean zero, unit variance, subgaussian), a KRP column has covariance $(\mathbb{1}\mathbb{1}^{\top})\otimes I\otimes\cdots\neq I_N$, so the columns are not isotropic.

failure_location.quote: The random matrix has independent and isotropic columns, i.e., $\expect[\V{\Omega}(:,k)] = \V{0}$ and $\expect[\V{\Omega}(:,k)\V{\Omega}(:,k)\t]  = \M{I}_{N}$ for $1 \leq k \leq \ell$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the missing hypothesis to def:subgauss (the entries of each $\M{\Omega}^{(j)}$ are independent); with it all proofs proceed as intended and no claim, rate, or advertised scope changes.
issues.overall_effect: Every KRP result that uses column isotropy or subgaussianity of $\V{\omega}_j\t\V{y}$ — lem:kronrank1, lem:kronrankell, thm:tantheta, thm:rrf, thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp, thm:added-2, thm:subspaceembed — is unproven for the distribution class actually permitted by def:subgauss.
issues.title: Isotropy lemma relies on entry independence not assumed in the KRP definition
issues.why_classification: A one-phrase hypothesis addition repairs the root and preserves every substantive claim and guarantee; only the clearly unintended wider distribution class is lost.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Let $\M{W} \in \R^{N \times r}$ have orthonormal columns and $\M{Z} \in \R^{N \times (N - r)}$.

issues.failure_explanation: In the partitioned SVD, $\M\Sigma_\perp\M{V}_\perp^{\top}\in\R^{(M-r)\times N}$ does not satisfy thm:tantheta's hypothesis $\M{Z}\in\R^{N\times(N-r)}$ (for this $Z$, $Z^{\top}\M\Omega$ is not even dimensionally defined). The legitimate choice is $\M{Z}=\M{V}_\perp\M\Sigma_\perp^{\top}\in\R^{N\times(M-r)}$, for which the matrix-Chernoff prefactor in the proof of thm:tantheta is the column count $M-r$, so the provable bound carries $\ln(4(M-r)/\delta)$ rather than the stated $\ln(4(N-r)/\delta)$. For $M\le N$ the stated (weaker) bound still follows, but for $M>N$ the stated $\Gamma$ is smaller than what the given argument yields, so thm:rrf is not established as stated; recovering the stated $N-r$ requires applying the argument to $(\M{V}_\perp\M\Sigma_\perp^{\top}\M\Sigma_\perp\M{V}_\perp^{\top})^{1/2}$ and restricting the Chernoff prefactor to its rank $\rho\le\min(M-r,N-r)$, an argument absent from the source.

failure_location.quote: Use the result from \cref{thm:tantheta} with $\M{Z} =\M\Sigma_\perp\M{V}_\perp\t $  and $\M{W} = \M{V}_r$ to obtain with probability at least $1-\delta$

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the invocation: either apply the thm:tantheta argument to the psd square root $(\M{V}_\perp\M\Sigma_\perp^{\top}\M\Sigma_\perp\M{V}_\perp^{\top})^{1/2}$ and restrict the Chernoff prefactor to its rank ($\le N-r$), which preserves the statement verbatim, or restate $\Gamma$ in thm:rrf (and the corresponding terms, or add $n_i\le n_i^{\circneq}$-type hypotheses, in thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp, thm:added-2) with the row-side log $\ln(4(M-r)/\delta)$.
issues.overall_effect: The main range-finder guarantee is unproven for tall matrices ($M>N$); the Γ-terms of thm:added-1 ($\Gamma_r$ with $\ln(8(n^d-r)/\delta)$), thm:rhsovd_krp and thm:added-2 (with the sketched-dimension log) are likewise unestablished whenever the row dimension of the sketched unfolding exceeds its column dimension.
issues.title: Range-finder proof misapplies the tan-theta lemma; Γ uses the wrong log factor for M > N
issues.why_classification: The repair requires either a contained but non-routine argument (square-root substitution plus rank-restricted Chernoff) or a limited weakening/restatement of constants in thm:rrf and three dependent theorems; structure and rates survive, so the loss is bounded but more than routine.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Consider a sequence $\{ \M{S}_k \}_{k=1}^S$ of independent, random, symmetric matrices of size $N \times N$.
As in Step 1 of the proof of \cref{thm:tantheta}

issues.failure_explanation: Matrix Chernoff requires independent summands and their expectation. Conditioned on $\mc{E}=\{\max_k\|\M{S}_k\|\le\Delta\}$, the summands $\M{S}_k=\M{W}^{\top}\M\Omega(:,k)\M\Omega(:,k)^{\top}\M{W}$ are no longer independent (and $\expect[\M{Y}\mid\mc{E}]\neq\ell\M{I}_r$), so the displayed conditional bound does not follow from thm:chernoff. The same defective step appears in Step 2 ('Apply matrix Chernoff inequality conditionally') and is repeated in the proof of thm:subspaceembed. A truncation argument (e.g., summands clipped at $\Delta$ are independent, psd, and bounded, with the lost mean controlled via the tails of lem:kronrank1/lem:kronrankell) is needed but not given.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace both conditional applications of matrix Chernoff by a truncation argument: clipped summands $\M{S}_k\mathbf{1}\{\|\M{S}_k\|\le\Delta\}$ are independent, psd, and uniformly bounded; $\M{Y}$ dominates their sum (lower tail) and the clipped mean is within $(\epsilon/2)\ell$ of $\ell\M{I}_r$ via a moment estimate from the exponential tails; all stated conclusions then survive.
issues.overall_effect: The concentration steps underpinning thm:tantheta (and eqn:interlower2, eqn:interupper2) and thm:subspaceembed are unjustified as written; transitively thm:rrf, thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp and thm:added-2 rest on them.
issues.title: Matrix Chernoff applied conditionally on a bound for the summands (independence lost)
issues.why_classification: Filling the gap requires a contained but genuinely nontrivial additional argument (truncation plus mean-shift control) at the core of the analysis; no statement, rate, or scope is lost, so it is more than minor but not serious.

issues.failure_explanation: Making $(N-r)(f(\varepsilon))^{\mu_{\max}/\Delta}\le\delta/4$ requires $\varepsilon^2/(2+\varepsilon)\ge\Gamma$, i.e., $\varepsilon$ at least the positive root of $\varepsilon^2-\Gamma\varepsilon-2\Gamma=0$, namely $(\Gamma+\sqrt{\Gamma^2+8\Gamma})/2$. This equals $2\Gamma$ only at $\Gamma=1$; for $\Gamma<1$ it is strictly larger (approximately $\sqrt{2\Gamma}$ as $\Gamma\to0$), a regime compatible with the hypotheses (e.g., $\ell$ close to $N$, $\strank(\M{Z})=1$, large $N$). Hence the substitution $\varepsilon=2\Gamma$ is invalid there, and eqn:interupper2 together with the $(1+2\Gamma)$ constants of thm:tantheta (and of thm:rrf, thm:added-1, thm:rhsovd_krp, thm:added-2) are not established as stated; the provable constant is $1+\varepsilon_+\approx1+\max\{2\Gamma,\sqrt{2\Gamma}\}$.

failure_location.quote: Set the upper bound equal to $\delta/4$, solve the quadratic equation for $\varepsilon$,  and choose the positive root to get $\varepsilon = 2 \Gamma$, where $\Gamma$ is defined in the statement of the theorem.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $\varepsilon=2\Gamma$ by the actual positive root $\varepsilon_+=(\Gamma+\sqrt{\Gamma^2+8\Gamma})/2$ and correspondingly replace $2\Gamma$ by $\varepsilon_+$ in the conclusions of thm:tantheta and the dependent theorems, or add an explicit hypothesis ensuring $\Gamma\ge1$.
issues.overall_effect: The $(1+2\Gamma)$-type constants in thm:tantheta, thm:rrf, thm:rhsovd_krp, thm:added-1 and thm:added-2 are unsupported in the legitimate regime $\Gamma<1$; the derivable bounds are weaker (square-root rather than linear in $\Gamma$) there.
issues.title: ε = 2Γ is not the positive root of the stated quadratic; (1+2Γ) constants unproven for Γ < 1
issues.why_classification: The correction is local but necessarily changes the stated constants of four theorems in a legitimate parameter regime (a limited weakening leaving recognizably comparable results); no proof architecture is affected.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Similarly, the assumptions on $\ell_l$ ensure that $\M{Q}$ with orthonormal columns, $\M{\Psi}\t\M{Q} \in \R^{\ell_l\times \ell_r}$ has a left-multiplicative inverse with high probability.

issues.failure_explanation: thm:rrf invoked with failure probability $\delta/2$ (i.e., with $\delta\to\delta/2$ in its hypotheses, which explains the 16 and 8 inside the logarithms) requires $\ell_r\ge8(r+rC_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_r/\delta))\ln(8r/\delta)$, but the theorem assumes only $\ell_r\ge r(1+C_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_r/\delta))\ln(8r/\delta)$ — a factor 8 short. Likewise, the Step-1 argument of thm:tantheta applied with $\M{W}=\M{Q}$ requires $\ell_l\ge8(\ell_r+\ell_rC_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_l/\delta))\ln(8\ell_r/\delta)$, whereas only $\ell_l\ge\ell_r(1+C_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_l/\delta))\ln(8\ell_r/\delta)$ is assumed. Under the stated hypotheses no $\epsilon\in[0,1)$ makes the Chernoff terms meet the $\delta/4$ targets, so the claimed failure probabilities, and hence the theorem's $1-\delta$ guarantee at the advertised sketch sizes, do not follow.

failure_location.quote: The assumptions on $\ell_r$ ensure that, by \cref{thm:rrf}, $\prob\{\mc{E}^c\}\le \delta/2$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen the two displayed lower bounds in thm:added-1 by the missing factor 8, i.e., $\ell_r\ge8(r+rC_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_r/\delta))\ln(8r/\delta)$ and $\ell_l\ge8(\ell_r+\ell_rC_{K,d}\ln^d(16\ell_l/\delta))\ln(8\ell_r/\delta)$; all conclusions then follow unchanged in form.
issues.overall_effect: The guarantee of thm:added-1 is unproven at the sketch sizes it states; no other labelled result uses thm:added-1.
issues.title: Sketch-size hypotheses of the single-view block-structure theorem are a factor ~8 too weak for the invoked results
issues.why_classification: A routine constant-factor strengthening of the hypotheses repairs the root; the method, conclusion, rates, and advertised scope (up to a constant in the sufficient sketch sizes) all survive.

issues.failure_explanation: Several failures in the derivation of the Ψ-term. (i) The symbol $\ell$ in $\strank(\M{Z})/\ell$ is undefined (presumably $\ell_l$). (ii) 'the proof of thm:tantheta', applied with $\M{W}=\M{Q}$ and $\M{Z}=\M{M}-\M{QQ}^{\top}\M{M}\in\R^{m^d\times n^d}$, has Chernoff dimension equal to the column count $n^d$ of $\M{Z}$, yielding a $\ln(4n^d/\delta)$-type factor — not the displayed $\ln(4(m^d-\ell_l)/\delta)$, which corresponds to no quantity in that argument. (iii) The statement's $\Gamma_l$ contains $\ln(8(m^d-\ell_r)/\delta)$, matching neither the proof's display nor the correct application. (iv) The factor $\ell_r$ in (eqn:twosided) is unjustified: $\|(\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Q})^{\dagger}\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Z}\|_F\le\|(\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Q})^{\dagger}\|_2\|\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Z}\|_F$ requires a rank bound on $\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Z}$ (at most $\min\{\ell_l,n^d,\operatorname{rank}\M{Z}\}$), not $\ell_r$; the alternative valid decomposition gives $\ell_r\|(\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Q})^{\dagger}\|_2^2\|\M{\Psi}^{\top}\M{Q}_\perp\|_2^2\|\M{Z}\|_2^2$, whose analysis produces a $\Gamma$ proportional to $(m^d-\ell_r)/\ell_l$, not $1/\ell_l$. (v) The stated final bound uses the undefined '$\M\Sigma_F$' and $\|\cdot\|_2^2$ where the proof establishes a Frobenius-norm bound, with mismatched parentheses and constant placements ($2\Gamma_r$ vs the proof's $\Gamma_r$ in event $\mc{E}$; $\Gamma_l$ vs the proof's $2\Gamma_l$); read literally as a $\|\M\Sigma_\perp\|_2^2$ bound it is false for flat spectra. Hence neither the intermediate nor the stated Ψ-side bound is established.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Rederive the Ψ-bound: either apply the thm:tantheta argument with $\M{Z}=\M{M}-\M{QQ}^{\top}\M{M}$ (Chernoff dimension $n^d$, rank factor $\min\{\ell_l,n^d\}$) or via $\M{Q}_\perp$ (factor $\ell_r$, $\Gamma\propto(m^d-\ell_r)/\ell_l$); define $\Gamma_l$ consistently, justify the rank/$\ell_r$ factor, and restate the conclusion as a Frobenius-norm bound $(1+2r(1+2\Gamma_r))(1+2k(1+2\Gamma_l))\|\M\Sigma_\perp\|_F^2$ with the corrected factors. A recognizably comparable guarantee survives.
issues.overall_effect: The Ψ-side term, $\Gamma_l$, the prefactor $\ell_r$, and the final constant form of thm:added-1 are unreliable: the stated guarantee is not derived, and its literal reading as a spectral-norm bound is false in general.
issues.title: Ψ-side error bound of the single-view theorem is misderived; stated Γ_l, ℓ_r factor, and final constant are unsupported
issues.why_classification: A contained rederivation plus restatement of the theorem's constants is required (no new global architecture, no abandonment of the result), but the fix is substantially more than routine and the stated constants do not survive verbatim.

issues.failure_explanation: The events $\mc{E}_t$ are cumulative-sum events, and $\mc{E}_t$ does not imply $\mc{E}_{t+1}$: writing $e_i$ for the mode-$i$ errors and $b_i$ for the budgets, $\{\sum_{i\le t}e_i\le\sum_{i\le t}b_i\}$ does not imply $\{\sum_{i\le t+1}e_i\le\sum_{i\le t+1}b_i\}$ when $e_{t+1}>b_{t+1}$, and such draws have positive probability (a bad sketch in mode $t+1$). So the asserted chain of inclusions is false. The subsequent law-of-total-probability chain does not use it (it needs only $\prob\{\mc{E}_{t+1}\mid\mc{E}_t\}\ge1-\delta/d$), so the conclusion is unaffected; however, the same proof also displays the step weakening $(1+2r_{t+1}(1+2\Gamma_{t+1}))$ to $(1+2r_{t+1}(1+\Gamma_{t+1}))$, which does not follow from the preceding line since $\Sigma\sigma_j^2(\M{G}^{(t)}_{(t+1)})\le\Sigma\sigma_j^2(\M{X}_{(t+1)})$ does not compensate the smaller constant. As written the proof contains false/invalid steps.

failure_location.quote: We know by \cref{thm:rrf}, $\prob\{ \mc{E}_1 \} \ge 1 -\delta/d$ and note that $ \mc{E}_1 \subseteq \dots \subseteq \mc{E}_t \subseteq \mc{E}_{t+1} \subseteq \dots \subseteq \mc{E}_d$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Delete or correct the false inclusion chain (the conditioning argument stands without it) and keep the factor 2 in the displayed weakening; no other change is needed.
issues.overall_effect: Only the internal correctness of the proof of thm:added-2 is compromised; its stated conclusion remains supported once the false nesting remark is removed and the constant restored.
issues.title: False event-nesting claim (and an invalid constant-weakening step) in the proof of the RSTHOSVD-KRP theorem
issues.why_classification: The defective assertions are not load-bearing; removing or correcting them is a short local repair that preserves the theorem and every guarantee.
